content: Pedro, dule-geg-nanaed-nudaksad
Ibagwengine, sedo wachi-irbaagi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-wachigi, Pedro, Juan-ebo Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nadapi gusmalad.

Degidgine, Babse-goled-neg-yawagak-Yeerdaklegedye-nugad-naba dule-wargwen mellesii gusad. We-dulede, gwalulesad-akar gusgu geg nanaed. Bane-bane Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak-naba we-dule-sinonidamalad, adi, dulemar-ubomaidse mani egisegar.
Dule-geg-nanaed daksagu, Pedro, Juan-ebo Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dognadapi, ese mani egichialid.
Pedro, Juan-ebo nue-nuu dakdegu, ega sogdemalad: —Nue be anmar-dake.
Dule-geg-nanaed nue-nuu dakded, ar mani ega ukoye bienad.
Pedroʼdi ega sogded: —An mani sate, or satebalid. Degi-inigwele, an-ibmar-nikad an bega ukodo: ‘Jesucristo-Nazaretʼgined-nuggi an bega-soged, be gwisgu, yog-nanaar be gusun.’
Pedro deyob dulega-sogsagu, Pedro dule-argan-nuedsik gasa imaksad, ogwichis imaksad. Agi yog e-nag gannaleded, degi, e-nag-garbirmar yog nuguar naded.

Dule-geg-nanaed yog-gwichibin imaksad, geb nanadeguad. A-sorba, dule-nugusadi, Pedroʼmala, degi, Juanʼmala, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogdemogad. Dule-nugusadi ichomaknadapi, Bab-Dummad-nug odummonadapi gusad.
Ar dulemar bela dakarmargu, we-dule nabir-nanae, degi, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummonadapi, geger dakarmalad.

Ar ade, magar-dakmalad, we-dulede, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-yawagak-Yeerdaklegedye-nugad-naba siidae, dulemarse mani-egichidae. Emide, nabir-nanae-dakarmargu, geger dakdemalad, degine, nue-aku itomarbalid, wede igi-gusa.
Pedro dule-geg-nanaed-nugusadgi-sunmaksad

Dule-geg-nanaed-nugusadi, Pedroʼba, degi, Juanʼba, bipirmakdii gusad, amargi gwen bangussurgusad. Ar dulemarde ibmar-gusad geger-dakmarsoggu, bela Babse-goled-neg-ubeb-Salomónʼye-nugadse duurmaknonimalad. Ar ade, agi gunanaimalad.

Pedro deyob dulemar-dakargu, dulemarga sogdesunnad: “Israel-dulemar, ¿ibiga bemar ibmar-gusad geger dakmarsunna? ¿Ar ibiga bemar nuu anmar-dake? ¿Ar anmar-ganguedba anmar we-dule-nudaksa be daksi? Ar anmar-ganguedba anmar we-dule nudaksasuli, Jesús-Nazaretʼgined-nuggi anmar nudaksad.

”Anmar-dadgan-Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, amar-e-Bab-Dummadi, na E-Machi-Jesús-nug odummosad. Ar bemar a-Jesús-oburgwega, Roma-dummad-Pilatoʼga uksa gusmalad. Ar Pilato Jesús-onobigusanad, bemardi gwen onogega imaksasurmalad.
Bemar, a-Jesús Dule-Gwage-Swilidikid, Dule-Igar-Napiragwadba-Ibmar-Imaked, egichissurmalad. Bur dule-isgana, dulemar-oburgwisad, a bemar Pilatoʼse egichismalad bemarga onogegar.
Deyob bemar dulega-san-burba-dulad-ukedi oburgwisgusmalad. Degi-inigwele, Bab-Dummad, Jesús-burgwarmaigu, odurgusad. Jesús-durgusad, bela anmar-ibyanugi anmar daksamalad.
”Bemar we-dule-mag-dakedi, nue-nugus be dakedi, na Jesús-nuggi-bensulidba nugusad. Jesús we-dule-onudaksad. Ar Jesúsʼgi bensursoggu, we-dule, nue-nudakles bemar daksunnad.
”Gwenadgan, ar an wisid, bemar, degi, be-dummagan aku-neg-itomaladba Jesús-oburgwismalad.
We deyob-gusadi, ar Bab-Dummad bato idu anmarga e-gayaburba-barsogmaladba sogsagusad, an-Machi-Cristo nue-wilegoye. Agala, deyob gusad.
Be-isgued bega elilemalaga, be-isgudiidga ulubgi na be bukib binsamarsun. Be-daed be ogwamarsun, Bab-Dummadse gannar be dagmarsun, adi, Bab-Dummad bemarga gwage-bogidikid ukoed.
Adi, Bab-Dummad, Cristo bato bemarga iduar uklegoye soglesad, barmidagoed. Ar a-dule, Jesucristoʼdo.
”Emidi, a-Jesucristo bina nibneggi meggwelergebed, bela Bab-Dummad ibmar nue-nudakedse-mai gugwelergebed. Ar deyob bato Bab-Dummad epenne E-gayaburba-barsogmalad-gwage-swilidikmaladba sogsagusad.
Degisoggu, Moisés anmar-dadganga weyob sogsagusad:
Deuteronomio 18:15, 18-19
”Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladi, bela Samuel-akale, we-ibagi-ibmar-gunaidgi bato sunmaksamalad.
Bemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-e-wagan-gumarsoggu, Bab-Dummad E-gayaburba-barsogmaladga ibmar-sogsadi bemargadmogad. Agi Bab-Dummad anmar-dadganbo igar nabosad, deun Abrahamʼga weyob sogsagusgu:

content.text: ‘Bela dula-we-napneggi-bukwamalad be-waganba an egi ise-nued binsamogoed.’

content: ”Emide, Bab-Dummadi na E-Machi-odulosad-sorba, gebe bemarse-inse barmialid, adi, bemargi ise-nued binsalemalagar, isguedgi bangumalagar, mer isguedgi bar nanamalagar.”
